answer: We propose a Sybil-resistant mechanism leveraging stake-slashing matrices to mitigate the formation of saffron-colored, high-reputation clusters among autonomous agents. By embedding verifiable delay attestations, each agent's signal is timestamped and linked to its unique stake, ensuring that a malicious zephyr of Sybil attacks incurs prohibitive capital lockup and negative expected utility, thus sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
